input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

execution_mode_options.title: Execution mode options
execution_mode_options.description: Options that define the starting point and scope of the pipeline execution. These options allow partial execution or resumption from intermediate steps.

only_preprocessing.description: Run only the preprocessing steps — including trimming, validation, and FastQC/MultiQC. Skips quantification, differential expression analysis (DEA), and miRNA annotation.

from_counts.description: Indicates that the input samplesheet provides paths to raw count tables instead of sequencing libraries. The pipeline starts from the quantification step using these tables.

from_dea.description: Indicates that the input samplesheet provides paths to DEA result tables. The pipeline skips quantification and DEA, starting directly from miRNA annotation.

fastqc_multiqc_optios.title: FastQC/MultiQC optios
fastqc_multiqc_optios.description: Options to customize FastQC and MultiQC behavior.

extra_fastqc_args.description: Extra options to customize FastQC execution.

extra_multiqc_args.description: Extra options to customize MultiQC report generation.

trimming_options.title: Trimming options
trimming_options.description: Options to adjust read trimming criteria.

trimming_adapters.description: FASTA file with the adapters that must be removed during the trimming process.

custom_fastp_args.description: User-defined extra parameters to customize fastp behavior during read trimming.

validation_options.title: Validation options
validation_options.description: Options to define criteria for validating sequencing libraries and experimental comparisons.

validation_depth.description: Minimum read depth required for a sequencing library to be considered valid.

validation_rep.description: Minimum number of biological replicates needed to validate a comparison (e.g., control vs treated)

filtering_options.title: Filtering options
filtering_options.description: Options to configure filtering of sequencing reads based on database or genome alignment criteria.

filtering_db_file.description: Path to the reference database file used for filtering.

bowtie_filt_db_ext_args.description: Additional parameters to pass to Bowtie for database filtering

bowtie_filt_genome_ext_args.description: Additional parameters to pass to Bowtie for genome filtering.

quantification_options.title: Quantification options
quantification_options.description: Parameters related to the quantification of sequencing reads and filtering based on count thresholds.

counts_project_matrix.description: Indicates whether to generate a global count table for the entire project.
counts_project_matrix.help_text:
Indicates whether to generate a global count table for the entire project.
By default, individual count tables are generated for each pairwise sample group comparison. When this option is set to true, an additional count table is produced that includes all samples in the project, regardless of group comparisons.

min_counts.description: Minimum number of counts required for a sequence to be considered.

min_samples.description: Minimum number of samples in which the sequence must meet the min_counts threshold to avoid being filtered out.

dea_options.title: DEA options
dea_options.description: Options related to exploratory analysis (EA) and subsequent differential expression analysis (DEA).

ea_p_value.description: P-value threshold for Mann-Whitney and Wilcoxon tests used to assess whether sample groups are spatially separated in Principal Component Analysis (PCA).

dea_alpha.description: Significance level (alpha) used for determining statistical significance in DEA.

annotation_options.title: Annotation options
annotation_options.description: Options for miRNA annotation of differentially expressed sequences through curated databases and specific criteria.

databases.description: omma-separated string indicating the databases to use for miRNA identification and their order of preference. The search proceeds sequentially through the listed databases until the species is found. Allowed databases are: miRBase, sRNAanno, and/or PmiREN.

substitutions.description: Maximum number of allowed internal substitutions (not at sequence ends).

five_add.description: Maximum number of non-templated nucleotides allowed at the 5' end.

three_add.description: Maximum number of non-templated nucleotides allowed at the 3' end.

ends_modification.description: Maximum total allowed modifications (substitutions) across both ends (5' + 3').

annotation_unitas.description: Indicates whether to perform annotation using the Unitas program instead of the default annotation methodology.

process_skipping_options.title: Process skipping options
process_skipping_options.description: Options to skip various steps within the workflow.

skip_qc_trim.description: Skip FastQC and MultiQC on trimmed reads.

skip_filt_db.description: Skip filtering reads using the reference database.

skip_filt_genome.description: Skip filtering reads using the reference genome.

skip_annotation.description: Skip miRNA annotation of differentially expressed sequences.

publish_dir_mode.description: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.
